name: Grand Hyatt Vail
insider_take: Alpine luxury meets Colorado charm at this ski-in, ski-out sanctuary where mountain adventures and refined elegance converge.
whats_special: The Grand Hyatt Vail sits at 8,150 feet elevation with direct access to Vail's legendary Back Bowls - some of the most coveted powder skiing in North America. The hotel's rooftop pool and hot tubs offer panoramic views of the Gore Range, while the spa features treatments using locally-sourced Rocky Mountain juniper and sage.
pro_tip: Book during "mud season" (late April-May) for incredible deals and enjoy hiking, mountain biking, and fewer crowds while still experiencing Vail's world-class dining and shopping scene.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature fire pit terrace for après-ski cocktails, and venture to nearby Booth Falls - a stunning 60-foot waterfall just a 2.5-mile hike from Vail Village. In summer, catch the free concerts at Ford Park or ride the Eagle Bahn Gondola to the top of Vail Mountain for breathtaking 360-degree views.
pros: Prime ski-in/ski-out location at Vail Mountain
Luxury alpine resort with premium amenities
Hyatt Privé program exclusive benefits and perks
cons: Premium pricing during peak ski season
Mountain resort location requires travel planning
